title: Arkret MLS KeyPackage Operation DTOs
description: Closed request and response DTOs for self and peer MLS KeyPackage upload, claim, claim-status query, consume, and revoke operations. Individual OpenAPI components reference the $defs entries in this bundle.

object_ref.description: Opaque content-addressed or service-scoped reference. Hash-shaped refs MUST use keypackage_digest for digest bytes.

keypackage_capability_id.description: Open registered identifier from keypackage-capability-registry.json. Unknown well-formed values are preserved but treated as unsupported.

keypackage_capability_set.description: UTF-8 byte-lexicographically sorted unique KeyPackage capability identifiers. Semantic registry membership and ordering are enforced after structural schema validation.
keypackage_capability_set.x-arkret-canonical-order: Sort by canonical encoded element bytes; elements MUST be unique.

keypackage_id.description: Arkret MLS-profile KeyPackage identity. This is the registered ak:mls:kp:<uuidv7> special form, not an opaque external identifier.

keypackage.description: Base64url encoding of the canonical MLS KeyPackage bytes.

cipher_suites.description: Generated from active canonical_id rows in mls-ciphersuite-registry.json.

last_resort.description: When true, this entry is a reusable last-resort KeyPackage (RFC 9420 Section 10). It remains published across claims and never enters the single-use claimed or consumed states; rotation, expiry, or explicit revocation transitions it to revoked with a registered revocation_reason. This application-layer flag is covered by the required upload batch endpoint_signature. Optional capability gated by ak.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1. See encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

actor_id.description: Complete holder ActorId; exact RFC 8785/JCS UTF-8 bytes equal the KeyPackage BasicCredential. Realm actor is bound to its owning Realm.

agent_id.description: Agent KeyPackage branch only. MUST equal principal_id and the current AgentSignerEvidence agent identity. It is never encoded as an ak:device identifier.

agent_verification_method.description: Agent runtime method that signed the exact KeyPackage; MUST match agent_key_authorize_event_id and the KeyPackage signature byte for byte.

agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Accepted active ak.agent.key.authorize Event that binds an Agent runtime verification method to this KeyPackage. Mutually exclusive with device_authorize_event_id.

last_resort.description: When true, this claim record returns a reusable last-resort KeyPackage (RFC 9420 Section 10) because the single-use pool was empty. The package may be reused within the same intended_realm_id and is not transitioned to consumed; the holder MUST rotate it and trigger group updates on next online. Optional capability gated by ak.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1. See encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

keypackage_claim_record.description: Complete holder identity is actor_id. Account/Agent retains its principal projection. Realm actor carries only its full RealmActorId and Device authorization; no principal mirror or Account fallback.

actor_id.description: Complete holder ActorId whose exact RFC 8785/JCS UTF-8 bytes are carried by every uploaded KeyPackage BasicCredential. The account principal MUST equal principal_id.

endpoint_signature.description: Required authoritative batch signature over the complete typed upload request with only this top-level signature omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.upload.create.v1 domain. The selected human device or Agent runtime endpoint signs the same transcript.

accepted_count.description: Number of KeyPackages accepted by this upload attempt; not a boolean or a delivery guarantee.

keypackage_refs.description: Accepted KeyPackage refs in request order; batch upload may accept more than one entry.

requester_authorization.description: Closed Account Device, Realm actor Device or Agent authorization. Full Realm requester identity is signed in requester_actor_id on the unsigned request, never a parallel principal mirror.

target_account_id.description: Exact cross-Station AccountId for the human-device target branch. It is forbidden for Agent targets.

requester_account_id.description: Exact cross-Station AccountId for the human-device requester branch. It is forbidden for Agent requesters.

target_keypackage_ref.description: Optional exact ordinary KeyPackage selector for a normal same-group Direct Conversation Add/Welcome after accepted member rejoin. When present, the owner authority atomically claims exactly this current, unconsumed package or returns the same opaque claim_failed result as every other target-side failure; it is never a best-effort hint.

target_agent_id.description: Agent exact-target branch only. This field is the sole target identity carrier and MUST match the Agent identity in the returned claim record and current AgentSignerEvidence.

target_agent_verification_method.description: Agent exact-target branch current runtime verification method.

target_agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Agent exact-target branch current accepted ak.agent.key.authorize Event.

peer_keypackages_claim_fields.description: Server-prepared immutable peer claim request fields before requester_authorization is attached. claim_request_id carries at least 128 bits of entropy and equals the Idempotency-Key value on the peer command.

target_account_id.description: Exact cross-Station AccountId for the human-device target branch. It is forbidden for Agent targets.

requester_account_id.description: Exact cross-Station AccountId for the human-device requester branch. It is forbidden for Agent requesters.

target_keypackage_ref.description: Optional exact ordinary KeyPackage selector for a normal same-group Direct Conversation Add/Welcome after accepted member rejoin. When present, the owner authority atomically claims exactly this current, unconsumed package or returns the same opaque claim_failed result as every other target-side failure; it is never a best-effort hint.

target_agent_id.description: Agent exact-target branch only. This field is the sole target identity carrier and MUST match the Agent identity in the returned claim record and current AgentSignerEvidence.

target_agent_verification_method.description: Agent exact-target branch current runtime verification method.

target_agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Agent exact-target branch current accepted ak.agent.key.authorize Event.

request.description: The exact participant-authorized unsigned request fields. Together with request_digest, this lets the destination bind a later Welcome and Direct Conversation binding to the durable claim without trusting source-service assertions.

peer_keypackage_claim_receipt.description: Destination-service-signed durable receipt. source_id and request are covered by the receipt signature; request_digest additionally binds the complete transport command, including participant authorization. Realm target receipts additionally sign claim_authority_ref from the actual claim acceptance cut; it must resolve to destination_id as that Realm's authority at claimed_at. Originals remain immutable across governance handoff.

keypackage_claim_terminal_receipt.description: The KeyPackage owner service signs an immutable terminal ledger fact. never_claimed is issued only after the request can no longer succeed; expired/revoked identify every formerly claimed ordinary KeyPackage. This is the portable cleanup authority for a failed Direct Conversation attempt.

keypackages_claim_response_body.description: Privacy-preserving peer success response. It intentionally omits inventory counts and per-device failure information.

claim_id.description: KeypackageClaimId of the claim to read, byte-identical to the Welcome keypackage_claim_ref. The caller's authenticated endpoint MUST be the claim record's exact endpoint.

keypackages_claim_query_request_body.description: Self read of one claim of the caller's own KeyPackage (ak.self.keys.keypackages.read.claim.v1). The response is the byte-identical keypackages_claim_response_body first serialized for the claim request that allocated claim_id.

recipient_account_id.description: Exact cross-Station recipient AccountId for the human-device signer branch. The Agent branch carries only its branch-specific identity.

recipient_id.description: For a Realm actor recipient, the original claim_receipt.destination_id (historical claim issuer), preserved across handoff and never used as the current HTTP route. Account/Agent retains its owning Station rule.

welcome_ref.description: Exact MlsWelcomeDelivery referenced by this durable receipt. The delivery is not an Event and has no independent RealmCommit.

welcome_digest.description: sha256:-prefixed lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the complete MlsWelcomeDelivery named by welcome_ref, producer_proof included. The consuming Station compares it with the Welcome binding it wrote on the claim ledger when it enqueued that delivery.

recipient_mls_durable_receipt.description: Recipient signs every field except signature after durable MLS installation. Closed XOR of Account Device, Agent, or Realm actor Device. Realm recipient_id binds the original claim issuer; the current governor consumes only a completely imported exact claim ledger.

keypackage_consume_receipt.description: Recipient Station signed durable consume acknowledgement. recipient_durable_receipt is the sole carrier of claim request, KeyPackage, Welcome, Realm, MLS group, epoch, and recipient service coordinates. The service-generated request_digest, claim_id, and consumed_at plus the complete nested durable receipt are covered by signature. For an ordinary KeyPackage it is issued only after the exact single-use claim transitions to consumed. For a reusable last-resort KeyPackage it terminally acknowledges only that exact claim audit while the KeyPackage row remains published. Same exact consume replays this receipt; any claim, coordinate, signer-branch or evidence mismatch conflicts.

recipient_durable_receipt.description: Sole consume authority and coordinate carrier. Its closed device or Agent signer branch authorizes the command and binds the owner, KeyPackage, Welcome, Realm, MLS group, epoch, and recipient service.

signature.description: Signature over the typed consume request with this field omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.command.consume.v1 domain.
Signature over the typed revoke request with this field omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.command.revoke.v1 domain.

peer_keypackages_claim_command_response_.description: Closed peer claim command result. First success and direct exact replay use the same durable state view as the read-only ledger query; unknown is impossible after a command has been admitted. Existing outcome bytes never cause a second claim.
